packageRules.description: Supply-chain cooldown: never propose a release younger than 7 days. Unlike pnpm's own minimumReleaseAge (kept at 1 day in pnpm-workspace.yaml so a fresh clone installs), this only delays update PRs, so the stricter floor costs nothing.
Restated rather than inherited from the rule above: Renovate merges matching rules in order, but the semgrep OWASP ruleset checks each packageRules entry in isolation.
